Subject: Request: Operational Resilience Questionnaire – First Harbor Bank (RFP# FH-2026-221)

Olga,

Thanks for engaging with First Harbor on our vendor review for inference platforms. Attached is our Operational Resilience Questionnaire (spreadsheet) for vendors responding to RFP FH-2026-221. We ask that you provide: per-question answers in the spreadsheet, a control mapping document (which maps your controls to our FFIEC-style expectations), and redacted evidentiary artifacts where possible (SOC 2 excerpts, network diagram, DR runbook excerpts, incident response playbooks, patching cadence/SLAs, and any audit logs or retention summaries you can share).

Primary review contacts on our side: me (Laura Bennett, Director, Vendor Risk) and the Vendor Risk Team (vendor_risk@firstharborbank.com). Our submission deadline for this tranche is COB 20 May; however, an earlier delivery (by 18 May) would be appreciated to allow internal risk scoring.

A few specific asks called out in the spreadsheet:
- Control assertions and evidence for continuity of operations (model serving) under GPU/region failure scenarios
- Details on patch management cadence and third-party dependency tracking
- Evidence of SOC 2 Type II and how the scope maps to hosted/dedicated/private deployments
- Any runbooks/extracts demonstrating RTO/RPO targets for model-serving endpoints and failover procedures

If you have any questions about the questionnaire items, please reach out directly. We may request a walkthrough call after we receive your package.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Director, Vendor Risk
First Harbor Bank

Thanks Olga — I'll take lead on the commercial appendix and a short SLA summary for resilience items. Quick notes for the evidentiary package:

- Pricing/terms: propose Dedicated baseline commit (monthly) + usage overage pricing. For Private (customer-managed), we'll include a professional services statement and a standard implementation checklist.
- SLA/fallback: include documented fallback policy that describes automatic routing to a cross-region replica, plus an explicit fallback to a lower-capacity hosted model variant. We'll state expected degradation behavior.
- Redaction: agree on redacting internal IPs and sensitive hostnames; provide an architecture diagram with logical components and hostcount ranges only.
- Legal/commercial: I'll sync with Legal on minimal redlines (data residency, liability caps tied to SLA breaches) and include a clause about audit rights limited to sampling.

I'll draft the commercial appendix and the short policy notes by 5/15 so Marissa can assemble the final bundle. Reference: deal_id FH-2026-221.
